name: canonkeeper
description: Turns a SillyTavern roleplay chat into a correct, self-maintaining World Info lorebook.

scripts.build:story: node bin/canonkeeper.js build fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --out .run/story --replay fixtures/story/recorded/replies.json && node bin/canonkeeper.js pin .run/story 'Brother Saul' && node bin/canonkeeper.js rerun fixtures/story/transcript.jsonl --run .run/story && node harness/gate.js --story fixtures/story --run .run/story
